tree.heading: Composition
tree.text: The Board shall have an Executive Board composed of—

children.text: the vice chairman of the Board;
the treasurer of the Board; and
an at-large member of the Board elected by the Board at its initial meeting.

tree.heading: Vacancies
tree.text: In the case of any vacancy which occurs in the position of at-large member before the expiration of such member’s term, the Board shall elect a replacement to complete that term.

tree.heading: Meetings
tree.text: The Executive Board shall hold not more than 4 regular meetings per calendar year. Special meetings may be held upon the call of the chairman or 3 members of the Executive Board.

tree.heading: Quorum
tree.text: A majority of the Executive Board shall constitute a quorum.

tree.heading: Powers
tree.text: The Executive Board may hold and use all the powers of the Board, subject to the approval of the Board.
